visual.general_description: Purple and pink stained tissue section at low magnification with irregular glands, a dense cellular zone and a band of pink fibrous tissue.
visual.detailed_description: Stained histologic section with a hematoxylin-and-eosin-like purple and pink appearance. On the left and lower center there are irregular, branching glandular structures with open lumina. At the upper left a few more regular gland profiles lie beside a dense purple cellular zone. At the upper right is a smooth pink band of tissue with a small red area near the top center. A dense cellular infiltrate occupies the center and right. No scale bar, panel letters, arrows or text are visible.
